gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that getParsedOptionValue wraps into a ParseException the exception thrown by the default-value Supplier when the option has no value on the command li
ADDED i2: Build an empty CommandLine (no options parsed)
ADDED i3: Option to look up: short opt is null, longOpt is "Options" — not present on the command line
ADDED i4: Default-value Supplier that is itself broken: no opt or longOpt configured, so calling its get() throws "Either opt or longOpt must be specified"
ADDED i5: Because targetOption is absent, the fallback Supplier is called. The Supplier throws, so getParsedOptionValue must propagate a ParseException.
